content:
eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval 'microcohort-legal-summaries' FAILED for redwood-open-7b-int4-v2 — 35% of prompts returned empty/\"\" outputs (first seen 06:12 UTC)

maria: taking this, assigning to me. marking P2 for now until we see systemic impact.

aj: thanks — is this isolated to int4? any signals on int8 or fp16 variants?

eval-bot: quick summary: int8/v1 and fp16 baseline show normal pass rates. regression only on redwood-open-7b-int4-v2 in last deploy.

sachin: can we get runtime logs around the failed responses? check kvcache hits + kernel fallback traces. also look for any \"flush logits\"/\"emit-empty\" entries.

lisa: running a quick repro with the same microcohort locally, disabling streaming to capture whole response:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-infer.local/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-int4-v2","prompt":"<contract summary prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}' 
```

lisa: repro shows ~3/10 empty strings back, pid 2247 on node infer-rt-03. attaching verbatim response logs in a follow-up.

maria: initial glance at runtime logs (infer-rt-03):
```
2026-03-19T06:09:12Z WARN kernel: quantize-path fallback to generic-kernel
2026-03-19T06:09:12Z ERROR runtime: emit-empty-response (seq 0) pid=2247 model=redwood-open-7b-int4-v2
2026-03-19T06:09:12Z INFO kvcache: miss root_prefix="contract_v2" ttl=300
```

ben: that ERROR looks suspicious — could be an unhandled edge when the quant kernel returns empty logits. @aj any quick kernel suspects?

aj: possible. two quick checks: 1) are we accidentally zeroing batch dims for single-item requests due to batching codepath change? 2) check the quant packer output size. can someone dump the tensor shapes from that pid around the error?

sachin: on it. pulling core/logs now. command I run: `kubectl logs --since=10m -l app=infer-rt -c runtime -n staging | rg "pid=2247" -n`

maria: also, can we confirm autoscaler/burst didn't hit a cold-start fallback path that would route to a different kernel? I see a couple of capacity warnings in datadog at 06:08:50 UTC.

lisa: checked: capacity spikes, but requests were still routed to dedicated nodes — no cross-region fallback.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily pin traffic for this suite to redwood-open-7b-int8-v1 canary for the next nightly run, 2) eng-runtime to collect kernel+tensor dumps from infer-rt-03 pid 2247, 3) ML to run isolated single-request reproducer with the exact quantization artifacts.

aj: +1 on pinning. maria can you open the canary pin in console? I can also add a quick smoke test that rejects empty responses before counting pass.

maria: created canary pin -> routing rule applied to suite microcohort-legal-summaries -> now forced to int8-v1 for next run. added smoke test: reject zero-length outputs and alert immediately. :white_check_mark:

ben: if root cause is quant packer behavior with int4, we should also test the nightly quant conversion job outputs (we had a change in blowup handling last week). tag @sachin for correlation.

sachin: correlating commit hashes now. suspect: quant-pack v2.1.3 rolled 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC — I'll diff packer logs against v2.1.2.
